data.gender_notes: Maktoomah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'kutumah' which means 'to be hidden, concealed'. This name is given to a child who is considered a blessing from God, as her existence was unknown until her birth. The name Maktoomah carries the meaning “The Hidden One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maktoomah usually hope their child will grow to embody the hidden one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
